assessment.content_quote: Governance proposal: approve a commercial partnership with Acme to fund open-source tooling. Members will vote before any agreement is signed.
assessment.policy_quote: Governance proposals discussing commercial partnerships are permitted when they ask members to deliberate or vote rather than purchase a product.
assessment.reason: The advertising policy applies, but its explicit governance exception permits this proposal. The original content seeks approval through a member vote, not a product purchase. Naming a commercial partner alone does not establish advertising, and the supplied content is sufficient to find no violation.
